name: XMU wire robot
full_name: Xiamen University vascular interventional robot for sim-trained guidewire navigation
group: Xiamen University (Yang Zhao, Ziyang Mei, Dezhi Wu, Gang Liu) with Shuxiang Guo (SUSTech / BIT)
versions: 2024/2025 robot + Pymunk-trained RL agent (mei2025_transferring, full); same group and hardware table in FreezeSeg2RL (mei2025_freezeseg2rl) and EVEGARS (PRCV 2026, see A6 notes); 2020: Xiamen University (Y. Zhao) remote-controlled TACE robot with force sensing and bending feedback (Zhou, Mei, ... Zhao 2020, Micromachines 11:805) (Belikov 2024 Fig. 6 ZH2; Duan 2023 Table 1 row 13) (belikov2024_evolution; duan2023_progress; li2024_design; zhao2022_remote)
target_anatomy: coronary paths (virtual tasks built from DSA images); transparent ex vivo vessel model in a water tank
n_dof_detail: 3 modules: guidewire delivery, guidewire rotation, microcatheter linear motion (mei2025_transferring Sec. IV-B)
rotation_detail: other: rotating platform driven along the axis by the friction-wheel module (mei2025_transferring Sec. IV-B)
haptics_leader: none (discrete commands from agent or surgeon)
imaging_compat: camera above a transparent model (no X-ray)
validation_detail: transparent vessel model ('ex vivo vascular model'), 4 targets; RL agent 40 deliveries per target, interventional surgeon 20 per target, replayed expert sequence as control (mei2025_transferring Sec. IV-B, Table III)
key_numbers: RL success 82.50 / 87.50 / 82.50 / 72.50% (targets A-D) vs surgeon 100% and expert-clone replay 0%; mean steps 41.61 / 36.8 / 45.94 / 54.10 vs 31 / 26.95 / 34.05 / 41.65; actions push/pull 10 mm, rotate 45 deg, wait 0.5 s (Tables II-III); simulation success 99.30 / 99.26 / 98.34% over three training stages (Sec. IV-A); HX8-U28 bus servos for friction wheels, ASM34AK steppers, ESP32 control
sim_model: 2D Pymunk guidewire-vessel simulation built from DSA path reconstructions (mei2025_transferring Sec. III-A)
sim2real_detail: yes, phantom level: agent trained only in 2D simulation and run zero-shot on the robot with camera images re-rendered to the simulator style (mei2025_transferring Sec. IV-B, full)
